newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers drop, Europe struggles to find buyers.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers drop, Europe struggles to find buyers.

text.p: ARA bunkers slid in line with the barge market, while prices in many other European ports were stable, and buyers everywhere were scarce, dealers said.

Rotterdam 380 CST traded down to as low as $97 fob as barge offers dropped to $95 fob. Many players, majors in particular, were keen to shed product by the end of the month (Friday). Buyers simply sat out, expecting further falls this week.
"Many suppliers just have to get rid of product by the end of the week, with hardly any buyers," one dealer said.
Total demand in the ARA area was under 10,000 tonnes, traders said.
However, 180 CST material held up, at around $106 fob, due to relative scarcity.
Hamburg bunkers were down to $109 fob for 380 CST. As in Rotterdam, demand was slight.
Mediterranean bunkers were mostly steady, although some suppliers said the total absence of enquiries left them unable to provide quotes.
"It's so calm, there just is no market," said one.
Fujairah prices were back down below $100 after their brief recovery late last week.
